title: When temporarily disconnected with Dexcom G6, backfill data comes well to xDrip+ but not to AAPS when reconnected.
symptom: When temporarily disconnected from Dexcom G6 for about 15 minutes, upon reconnection, backfill data appears in xDrip+ but not in AAPS.
cause: xDrip is probably sending always only last value, whereas BYODA sends last XX values and AAPS accepts all changes.
fix: Use BYODA instead of xDrip as collector, or report the issue to xDrip project.
evidence_quote: BOYDA always send last XX values (as they may change in the past because of smoothing) and AAPS accepts all changes xDrip is probably sending always only last value
